name: Ryuuou no Oshigoto!
original_name: りゅうおうのおしごと！
source:
Kuzuryuu Yaichi is a prodigy shogi player who won the title of Ryuuou at the age of 16. Following his victory, he has been in a slump until he is approached by Hinatsuru Ai, a 9-year-old girl who begs him to make her his disciple. Astonished by Ai's potential, Yaichi agrees to become her master, and the two then brave themselves together in the world of shogi with their friends and rivals. However, this comes with the condition imposed by Ai's mother that Yaichi is to marry Ai if she does not become a major player before graduating middle school. 

[Edited from Wikipedia]
translation:
九头龙八一是一名天才将棋棋手，年仅16岁便夺得了“龙王”头衔。获胜之后，他却陷入低潮，直到一名9岁的女孩雏鹤爱找上门来，恳求他收自己为徒。爱的潜力让八一大为惊讶，于是，他答应成为她的师父。此后，两人与伙伴、对手们一起，在将棋世界中奋勇前行。不过，爱的母亲也提出了一个条件，若爱在初中毕业前未能成为出色的棋手，八一就必须娶她。

[编译自维基百科]
